title: The extent to which, by which time
summary: Mệnh đề quan hệ trang trọng: the extent to which, the way in which, by which time, at which point, the reason for which, whereby.

dialogue.en: Did you read the report on online learning?
dialogue.vi: Bạn đọc báo cáo về học trực tuyến chưa?

dialogue.en: Yes. It studies [[the extent to which]] students benefit.
dialogue.vi: Rồi. Nó nghiên cứu học sinh được lợi đến mức nào.

dialogue.en: And [[the way in which]] teachers adapt?
dialogue.vi: Còn cách giáo viên thích ứng?

dialogue.en: That too. The study ran until 2024, [[by which time]] most schools had reopened.
dialogue.vi: Cũng có. Nghiên cứu chạy đến 2024, lúc đó hầu hết trường đã mở lại.

dialogue.en: Did they suggest a new system?
dialogue.vi: Họ có đề xuất hệ thống mới không?

dialogue.en: A system [[whereby]] students choose their own pace.
dialogue.vi: Một hệ thống mà học sinh tự chọn tốc độ học.

sections.heading: The extent to which, the way in which
sections.rule: Văn trang trọng đặt **giới từ trước which**: **the extent to which** (mức độ mà), **the way in which** (cách mà), **the reason for which**, **the degree to which**.

examples.en: We studied [[the extent to which]] prices affect sales.
examples.vi: Chúng tôi nghiên cứu giá ảnh hưởng doanh số đến mức nào.
examples.why: The extent to which + mệnh đề.

examples.en: I like [[the way in which]] she explains things.
examples.vi: Tôi thích cách cô ấy giải thích.
examples.why: The way in which = the way.

check.prompt: The report looks at the degree ___ which people trust the news.

sections.heading: By which time, at which point, in which case
sections.rule: Sau dấu phẩy, **giới từ + which + danh từ** nối thêm thông tin: **by which time** (đến lúc đó), **at which point** (vào lúc đó), **in which case** (trong trường hợp đó).

examples.en: We arrived at ten, [[by which time]] the show had ended.
examples.vi: Chúng tôi đến lúc mười giờ, đến lúc đó buổi diễn đã kết thúc.
examples.why: By which time: đến lúc đó.

examples.en: He started shouting, [[at which point]] I left.
examples.vi: Anh ấy bắt đầu la hét, lúc đó tôi bỏ đi.
examples.why: At which point: ngay lúc đó.

examples.en: It may rain, [[in which case]] we'll stay inside.
examples.vi: Có thể trời mưa, khi đó chúng ta sẽ ở trong nhà.

check.prompt: The bus may be late, in ___ case we'll take a taxi.

sections.heading: Whereby: theo đó, nhờ đó
sections.rule: **whereby** = theo đó / nhờ đó (một hệ thống, thỏa thuận, cách làm). Rất trang trọng, hay gặp trong văn bản chính thức.

examples.en: They signed an agreement [[whereby]] both sides share profits.
examples.vi: Họ ký thỏa thuận theo đó hai bên chia lợi nhuận.
một hệ thống theo đó người dùng trả hàng tháng

check.prompt: They created a scheme ___ workers can buy shares.

mistakes.wrong: We measured the extent which it helped.
mistakes.right: We measured the extent to which it helped.

mistakes.wrong: The way how she talks is funny.
mistakes.right: The way she talks is funny.

mistakes.wrong: We got there at nine, by that time it was dark.
mistakes.right: We got there at nine, by which time it was dark.
mistakes.why: Nối mệnh đề → by which time.

mistakes.wrong: It may snow, in that case we'll cancel.
mistakes.right: It may snow, in which case we'll cancel.
mistakes.why: Nối mệnh đề → in which case.

mistakes.wrong: The degree in which people agree varies.
mistakes.right: The degree to which people agree varies.

exercises.prompt: The study examines the extent ___ which diet affects sleep.
The meeting lasted until six, ___ which time everyone was exhausted.
She told a joke, at ___ point everyone laughed.
They agreed on a plan ___ each team gets equal funding.

options: I don't like the way how he speaks.
I don't like the way in which he speaks.
exercises.explain: The way in which (không dùng the way how).

exercises.prompt: We may be late, in ___ case please start without us.
The report shows the degree ___ which the river is polluted.
We left at eight, by which ___ the roads were empty.
It was a system ___ staff could work from home.

exercises.vi: Tôi thích cách cô ấy dạy.
Có thể trời mưa, khi đó chúng ta ở nhà.

exercises.sentence: We studied the extent which people use apps.
answers: We studied the extent to which people use apps.

exercises.sentence: He arrived at noon, by that time we had left.
answers: He arrived at noon, by which time we had left.

exercises.sentence: Look at the way how they work together.
answers: Look at the way they work together.

exercises.vi: Nghiên cứu xem xét mạng xã hội ảnh hưởng đến giới trẻ đến mức nào.
answers: The study examines the extent to which social media affects young people.
The study looks at the extent to which social media affects young people.
The research examines the extent to which social media affects young people.
The study examines the extent to which social media influences young people.
The study examines how much social media affects young people.

exercises.vi: Chúng tôi đến lúc chín giờ, lúc đó mọi người đã về hết.
answers: We arrived at nine, by which time everyone had left.
We arrived at nine, by which time everyone had gone home.
We got there at nine, by which time everyone had left.
We got there at nine, by which time everyone had gone home.
We arrived at nine o'clock, by which time everyone had left.
